title: How to Find a Deep, Spiritual Partner in Islamabad. Tip #1
body: Ask his moon sign before you ask what he does. If he says "I don't really believe in all that," walk away. If he checks his Co-Star before agreeing to a date, that's a good sign. Mention Mercury retrograde and watch whether he takes it seriously. The real ones do a full moon circle on a rooftop in F-7 without laughing at themselves. He's cut a cord with his mother, journalled his Saturn return, and calls Margalla Trail 5 his grounding spot. That's the one.
caption:
Tip #1: if he doesn't know his rising sign, move on.
